description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTwigCallable' within the Twig templating engine, implementing the TwigCallableInterface. It provides mechanisms for managing callable entities, including their options, context, deprecation info, and name handling, used for extending Twig's functionality.

classes.name: AbstractTwigCallable
classes.description: An abstract base class for encapsulating callable objects in Twig, with support for options, deprecation handling, and dynamic naming.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the callable with a name, optional callable, and options, including deprecation info handling.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the callable, including class name and its name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the static name of the callable.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns the dynamic name of the callable.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the node class associated with this callable, from options.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Checks if charset information is needed.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Checks if environment context is needed.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Checks if rendering context is needed.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a clone of this callable with updated dynamic arguments and names.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method to set arguments; use 'withDynamicArguments' instead.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable accepts a variable number of arguments.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: triggerDeprecation
methods.description: Triggers the deprecation warning for this callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the package that deprecates this callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the version when this callable was deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the suggested alternative.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates the minimal number of arguments required based on options and current arguments.
